en.title: Lab Work
en.summary: Work at this branch that is out at a laboratory, overdue, or back and waiting to be fitted.

sections.heading: Open cases
sections.body:
Every case not yet fitted or cancelled: a docket still being prepared, work at the lab (soonest due first, overdue marked), and work back and ready to fit. Each row moves on with one button — sent, received, fitted, sent back for a remake, or cancelled. Sending and sending back use the laboratory's usual turnaround as the due date.

New work is sent from the patient's Lab work tab, where the tooth and the treatment are.

sections.heading: How the laboratories have done
sections.body:
For work sent in the past year: how many cases, the turnaround the lab says, the days it actually took on average, how many came back late and by how much, and how many went back for a remake. It is the table to read before deciding which laboratory gets the next crown.

Needs the lab_cases.manage permission.

am.title: የላቦራቶሪ ሥራ
am.summary: በዚህ ቅርንጫፍ በላቦራቶሪ ያለ፣ የዘገየ፣ ወይም ተመልሶ ለመግጠም የሚጠብቅ ሥራ።

sections.heading: ክፍት ሥራዎች
sections.body:
ገና ያልተገጠመ ወይም ያልተሰረዘ ሥራ ሁሉ፦ በዝግጅት ላይ ያለ፣ በላቦራቶሪ ያለ (የዘገየው ምልክት አለው)፣ እና ተመልሶ ለመግጠም ዝግጁ የሆነ። እያንዳንዱ መስመር በአንድ ቁልፍ ይቀጥላል።

አዲስ ሥራ ከታካሚው የላቦራቶሪ ሥራ ትር ይላካል።

sections.heading: ላቦራቶሪዎቹ እንዴት ሠሩ
sections.body:
ባለፈው ዓመት ለተላከ ሥራ፦ ስንት ሥራ፣ ላቦራቶሪው የሚለው ጊዜ፣ በአማካይ የፈጀው ቀን፣ ስንቱ ዘግይቶ እንደመጣ፣ እና ስንቱ እንደገና እንዲሠራ እንደተመለሰ።

የlab_cases.manage ፈቃድ ይፈልጋል።
